The '''Resolute Protector Armor''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] set available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Resolute Protector Armor was first introduced in the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] as part of the Seneschal's Stronghold Pack available on October 14th, 2014.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://dulfy.net/2014/07/26/swtor-architect-and-seneschals-stronghold-pack|text=SWTOR Seneschal's Stronghold Pack|date=2014-07-26|archivedate=20180621115011}}</ref>
